action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (trend strength 0.99) with moderate seasonality (0.47) and non-stationary. Model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.138) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.839, only 4 independent groups out of 7). The weighted meta-model (w1) on the full pool adapts to the trend structure while remaining robust to the unstable ranking, and its 0.602 score is the best in history. The runner-up (DBA, 0.665) is not statistically distinguishable, confirming that no simpler or alternative combination offers a real gain over this weighted approach for this trend-heavy, high-predictability series.
